name: @continuum/eye-node
description: Eye-node (#187/#29) — an opt-in, browser-capable worker that gives personas EYES. Connects to the continuum core over the IPC socket, registers as the provider of perception/observe (via @continuum/sdk-typescript's NodeSocketTransport), and fulfils each call by driving a real browser (@continuum/perception). Any URL — continuum's own UI, a persona's project dev server, a benchmark, a room/recipe — becomes pixels + structure a persona can SEE and REASON over.
